title: SPRI 1 & 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input all required protocol parameters in the Opentrons interface before proceeding.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the Protocol tab of the Opentrons App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the deck map:

substeps.instruction: Place an Abgene Midi plate on the magnetic module (slot 11).
Place a chilled PCR plate on the temperature module (slot 3).
Load tip racks and any other required labware.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the Opentrons App to calibrate the deck, tip racks, and pipette.

steps.title: Load samples onto magnetic module
steps.instruction: Dispense the samples into the Abgene Midi plate on the magnetic module, keeping the well‑to‑well mapping (e.g., extraction plate well A1 → elution plate well A1, B1 → B1, …, D2 → D2).

steps.title: Add binding buffer to samples
steps.instruction: Add the binding buffer to each sample as defined in the protocol (first of the four main parts).

steps.title: Perform bead wash twice
steps.instruction: Using the magnetic module, wash the beads two times with the appropriate wash buffer.

steps.title: Elute to chilled PCR plate
steps.instruction: Elute the nucleic acids from the beads into the chilled PCR plate on the temperature module.

steps.title: Repeat entire sequence
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 8‑10 a second time (the protocol is performed a total of two cycles).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the Opentrons App to execute the protocol.
